letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Software Engineer position with Example Hiring Team. My background centers on reliable API and data-platform work, with particular experience designing recoverable asynchronous systems, instrumenting service boundaries and helping engineers turn operational failures into durable tests and clearer delivery decisions.

At Example Systems, I designed a PostgreSQL-backed job queue with idempotent workers and recovery tests for interrupted tasks. I also introduced OpenTelemetry traces across API and worker boundaries, helping on-call engineers isolate slow requests. As the system moved from synchronous processing to background jobs, I led design reviews and documented staged migration and rollback criteria. I then mentored engineers through incident reviews and paired with them on regression tests covering duplicate delivery and partial failure.

Previously, at Sample Cloud, I implemented versioned Node.js APIs and contract tests, profiled database workloads before changing queries and indexes, and built an accessible React console for reviewing and selectively retrying failed jobs. Earlier Python import work strengthened my focus on data integrity through explicit rejection of ambiguous records and integration tests for CSV, Unicode and date handling.

My independent Queue Observatory project extends this focus: it reproduces worker crashes, compares retry policies and provides runnable test cases and design notes for idempotency-key expiry and recovery verification. Together with my experience in TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis and OpenTelemetry, this gives me a practical foundation for the reliability and tracing priorities described in your role.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss your service architecture, recovery expectations and observability practices, and how I could contribute to dependable delivery at Example Hiring Team.

Sincerely,
Renée Ionescu
